blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Many erring personnel of the Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR) have been investigated and charged in connection with alleged abuses linked to the issuance of letters of authority (LOAs), according to BIR Commissioner Charlito Martin Mendoza. Mendoza mentioned this in response to Sen. JV Ejercito’s query at a budget hearing in the Senate on Tuesday. READ: Erwin Tulfo flags alleged BIR money-making scheme via LOAs “Were there any BIR employees that have been investigated dahil dito sa pang-aabuso ng letter of authority?” Ejercito, chairman of the Senate committee on finance, asked.
